features.description: Open-source AI coding agent for VS Code (Cline fork) with file system access, terminal control and multi-step workflows; also on Open VSX.
The Roo Code extension was shut down on May 15, 2026; the docs direct users to the community fork ZooCode and to Cline, from which Roo Code originated.
Specialized personas: Code (default), Architect, Ask, Debug and Orchestrator, each with different capabilities and access levels.
Each mode remembers its last-used model and persists between sessions; Roo switches models automatically when you change modes.
Four ways to switch: dropdown, /architect /ask /debug /code /orchestrator slash commands, Cmd/Ctrl+. shortcut, and Roo-suggested mode switches.
Create your own modes with slug, name, description, prompts and tool access groups (YAML or UI).
Break complex projects into subtasks; each subtask runs in its own context, often in a tailored mode, and reports back to the orchestrator.
Per-action permission tiles with All/None chips and a global Enabled toggle; Cmd/Ctrl+Alt+A shortcut and command-palette toggle.
Shadow-git snapshots before file modifications; View Differences and Restore (files only, or files plus task); enabled by default and needs no GitHub account.
Embeddings-based semantic code search across the project; supports Google Gemini, OpenAI, Ollama, OpenRouter, Mistral, Vercel AI Gateway and Bedrock providers.
@-mentions bring files, folders, problems and git commits into the conversation.

Tools include read_file, write_to_file, apply_diff, search_replace, list_files, search_files, execute_command, codebase_search, use_mcp_tool, access_mcp_resource, new_task, run_slash_command, switch_mode, generate_image, update_todo_list, ask_followup_question and attempt_completion.
Persistent behaviors, preferences and constraints via workspace and global rules directories such as ~/.roo/rules.
Task-specific instruction packages loaded on demand when your request matches the skill purpose.
Automate repetitive tasks with markdown command files in .roo/commands/ (project) or ~/.roo/commands/ (global), manageable in Settings.
Connect MCP servers for extra tools and resources (stdio and SSE transports documented).
Central hub for discovering and installing extensions: MCP servers and custom modes.
Work multiple branches of the same repo simultaneously; each worktree opens its own VS Code window with Roo Code.
AI summarization of earlier conversation parts while retaining key information and preserving slash commands.
Specify files and directories Roo cannot access or modify, like .gitignore for the agent.

Dozens of providers: Anthropic, OpenAI (including ChatGPT Plus/Pro), Gemini, DeepSeek, Ollama, LM Studio, OpenRouter, Bedrock, Vertex, LiteLLM, Mistral, Moonshot, MiniMax, Qwen Code, Requesty, SambaNova, Fireworks, Baseten, Vercel AI Gateway, VS Code LM, xAI and Z AI.
Run models locally on Ollama or LM Studio for privacy, offline use and cost savings.
Create and switch between sets of AI settings, with different configurations per mode.
Interactive, persistent checklists in the chat that track progress through multi-step workflows.
Executes commands in your terminal and intelligently processes their output for bidirectional automation.
AI quick-fixes from the VS Code lightbulb menu, context-aware without switching to chat.
The agent sees and can fix VS Code Problems-panel errors, warnings and other diagnostics.
Wand icon in the chat input refines your prompt to be clearer and more specific before sending.
Generate or edit images from text prompts and save them to the project (experimental; requires OpenRouter).
Queue multiple follow-up messages while Roo is working; they are processed sequentially.
One-click suggested answers to Roo follow-up questions, shown as buttons under the chat input.
Reads AI responses aloud via a speaker icon next to each response (settings toggle).
Interface localized in 18 languages including English, Chinese, Spanish, Hindi, French, German, Japanese and more.
Reads multiple workspace files in a single step instead of one by one.
Edits multiple files in a single operation; graduated from experimental and enabled by default.
Applies file edits in the background without interrupting you with automatic diff views.
Define TypeScript or JavaScript tools Roo can call like built-ins; automatically approved when enabled.
Keyboard navigation including mode cycling (Cmd/Ctrl+.) and an auto-approve toggle (Cmd/Ctrl+Alt+A).
Back up, share or restore configuration via export, import and reset options.
Per-mode temperature tuning to trade precision against creativity.
Roo Code nightly release channel for pre-release features.
Third-party custom-mode system (GreatScottyMac) that maintains persistent project context in markdown memory files; not part of Roo core docs.
